reasoning_cat1: "When a Note Receivable is sold by Fund in accordance with the terms of this Agreement, Lender shall release the Lender's Liens" makes the release turn on the wholly unspecified phrase "in accordance with the terms of this Agreement", and "against payment of the agreed amount therefor" leaves it unclear who fixes the agreed amount and whether payment is a condition of release.
reasoning_cat2: It must be squared with Permitted Dispositions (c127)(e), which requires a cash price of at least 80% of the unpaid balance paid directly to a Cash Management Account, with 2.6(a)(iii)'s direct-payment requirement and with 4.1's flat prohibition on disposing of Collateral — whether a sale outside those terms nonetheless releases the Lien is a genuine internal conflict.

reasoning_cat2: Its exceptions run to Permitted Dispositions (c127), Permitted Investments (c129), Section 7.10 payments and Permitted Reorganizations (c133), and "Affiliate" carries a special 10% deeming rule under c008 expressly "for purposes of ... Section 7.13"; whether transfers to affiliated entities were permitted turns on how all of these fit together.
